#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int N, M, K, C, D;
    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
    vector<int> a(K);
    vector<int> starts(N, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        a[i]--;
        starts[a[i]]++;
    }
    int maxT = K + N + 1;
    int V = (maxT + 1) * N + 2;
    int src = V - 2;
    int sink = V - 1;
    vector<vector<tuple<int, int, int>>> graph(V);
    auto add_edge = [&](int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        graph[u].push_back({v, cap, cost});
    };
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        if (starts[i]) add_edge(src, i, starts[i], 0);
    }
    for (int t = 0; t <= maxT; ++t) {
        add_edge(t * N, sink, K, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int t = 0; t <= maxT; ++t) {
            add_edge(t * N + i, (t + 1) * N + i, K, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        u--; v--;
        for (int t = 0; t < maxT; ++t) {
            add_edge(t * N + u, (t + 1) * N + v, 1, C + (2 * 0 + 1) * D);
            add_edge(t * N + v, (t + 1) * N + u, 1, C + (2 * 0 + 1) * D);
        }
    }
    // Placeholder for flow calculation
    cout << 0 << "\n";
    return 0;
}
